name: Miyuki MainMenu Music
teaser: This simple mod adds music to the menu (without replacing the game music)
description_html:
What This Mod Does?

  • This simple mod adds music to the menu (without replacing the game music)
  • Plays a random song at startup
  • Supports playlists
  • Supports changing playlists by pressing keys
  • Supports changing music by pressing keys
  • Supports pausing and stopping music by pressing keys
  • Stops playback in raid
  • Add ur music and musicfolder in BepInEx\plugins\MiyukiMainMenuMusic\music (mp3 only)
settings

Press F12 open mod settings

  • You can change the volume

  • You can change the control buttons

  • You can change the UI Timer (wait 2.0.1)

  • You can Enable Or Disable UI (wait 2.0.1)

  • You can view the current Song name Debug info

  • You can view the current Folder name Debug info

  • You can view the current Song ID Debug info

  • You can view the current Folder ID Debug info

Installation

  1. download the latest release zip.

  2. Extract the zip so that MiyukiMainMenuMusic ends up in:

    BepInEx/plugins/  >> MiyukiMainMenuMusic <<
important!

I just wanted to add my own music to the menu.

It does not replace the default music, you can mute it in the game settings.

Please report any errors or bugs you find, I will try to fix them.

This mod does not break the game or cause irreversible changes, and it should be compatible with all possible mods!

in theory, it should work with both old and future versions. Please let me know if you have installed it on older versions.

currently, every mod action is logged in the console, it doesn’t affect the FPS, but if it bothers you, please let me know, I will disable the logs in the next versions or add a switch in the settings
